location: R4 burning house and shared main room
time: R4 at night; late personal order; presented first as a cold open
scene_purpose: Promise urgent relationship loss and establish that Moss outranks possessions.
entry_state: The protagonist returns over the ridge carrying portal materials and sees the house already burning.
objective: Reach Moss through the shortest available route.
reason_objective_matters: Moss is the shared-life stake and the opening cannot imply that the protagonist pauses to save property.
obstacle: The wool rug and timber interior are burning while Moss is not visible from outside.
tactics: Drop crying obsidian and glowstone, place water towards the room and break the shortest wall.
information_revealed: The protagonist spends no action on storage and has returned with unexplained portal materials.
information_withheld: The fire's cause, Moss's location and the meaning of the materials remain unknown.
emotional_progression: Shock to concentrated rescue, then interruption.
visual_event: Water crosses the burning rug as the protagonist reaches through smoke.
turn: The image cuts before the room is visible.
outcome: The rescue remains unresolved but its priority is clear.
exit_state: The rescue remains unresolved but its priority is clear.
new_question: What happened while he was away, and is Moss still inside?
story_value: Hook, emotional orientation and material mystery.
production_requirements: Set and state: R4 house in a controlled partial-fire condition. Props and mechanics: dropped crying obsidian, glowstone, water placement and a breakable rescue wall. Continuity and capture: exact action and camera match for SC-10; no mechanical validation is claimed.

time: R0 morning; personal order 1 after the cold open
scene_purpose: Establish the pair, blank survey journal and surface composition later revealed as the portal destination.
entry_state: The protagonist and Moss have reached an unvisited but resource-rich clearing.
objective: Decide whether to stop and establish a base.
reason_objective_matters: The choice defines home before the portal makes location unstable.
obstacle: The ravine is remote, but it offers water, stone, timber and a natural overlook.
opposing_agent: Terrain, distance and ordinary survival needs.
tactics: Check the map, draw the ravine symbol, let Moss settle and place a temporary marker.
information_revealed: Moss and the protagonist are already a functioning pair and voluntarily choose the place.
information_withheld: An active crying portal waits below and the scene is the far end of the final connection.
visual_event: Moss sits at the ledge while the clean journal opens on the first ravine sketch.
turn: A low hum from below changes settlement into investigation.
outcome: They descend together rather than beginning construction immediately.
exit_state: They descend together rather than beginning construction immediately.
new_question: What could be active beneath an untouched clearing?
story_value: Relationship foundation, audience orientation and final-image setup.
production_requirements: Set and capture: repeatable R0 morning clearing, ravine overlook and locked wide-shot position. Performance and props: controlled Moss mark, clean journal insert, ravine symbol and temporary marker. Continuity: preserve lighting, blocking and audio references for SC-13.

time: R0 later that morning; personal order 1
scene_purpose: Pose the title question and make the first entry an accountable decision.
entry_state: The pair follow the hum into a cave with no player route or mine.
objective: Explain enough of the active frame to decide whether to cross.
reason_objective_matters: The frame is the only evidence capable of challenging the protagonist's private-world knowledge.
obstacle: A complete crying-obsidian portal should not behave like a normal Nether frame and has no local construction evidence.
opposing_agent: The impossible active threshold and uncertain destination.
tactics: Inspect coordinates, frame faces, surrounding natural blocks and absence of dropped or written evidence; keep Moss close before crossing.
information_revealed: The portal is deliberate in shape but has no local builder or approach history.
information_withheld: It is the receiving mouth of the protagonist's final R4 construction.
emotional_progression: Curiosity to unease, then chosen risk.
visual_event: The protagonist's hand and Moss's silhouette enter the purple plane together.
turn: He chooses action when inspection reaches its limit.
outcome: Both leave R0 through the impossible frame.
exit_state: Both leave R0 through the impossible frame.
new_question: Does it lead to the Nether, another location or another version of this place?
production_requirements: Set and effects: complete active crying-obsidian hero frame in an untouched natural cave, with a transition language distinct from a vanilla Nether portal. Blocking and continuity: safe repeatable player-and-wolf entry, coordinate insert and matching frame geometry for SC-11.

location: R1 Rain Echo ravine and R2 Ash Echo threshold
time: R1 and R2 during the first two crossings; personal order 2
scene_purpose: Deliver confusion, exploration and the failed assumption that re-entry returns home.
entry_state: The pair emerge beside the same granite seam under persistent rain and a new watercourse.
objective: Verify the place, then return to R0.
reason_objective_matters: Moss, supplies and the intended home all remain on the far side as far as the protagonist understands.
obstacle: Natural geography matches while the surface state contradicts the clearing they left.
opposing_agent: The echo environment and an incorrect reversible-door model.
tactics: Compare coordinates, climb to the surface, inspect landmarks and re-enter the frame.
information_revealed: The portal preserves place more reliably than reality state.
information_withheld: The one-way chain and ultimate destination remain unknown.
emotional_progression: Disorientation to cautious confidence, then sharper alarm.
visual_event: Rain vanishes at the transition and an ash-coloured tree line replaces it.
turn: The attempted return produces another unfamiliar reality.
outcome: The protagonist can no longer assume that turning round means going back.
exit_state: The protagonist can no longer assume that turning round means going back.
new_question: How can he test whether these are distinct realities rather than one changing world?
story_value: Requested first-return reversal and portal-rule foundation.
production_requirements: Sets and capture: coordinate-matched R1 rain and R2 ash ravine states with a fixed granite profile, waterfall, vegetation and tree-line variants. Blocking and effects: two controlled player-and-wolf crossings, matched thresholds and an audible rain-to-dry-wind transition.

location: R2 Ash Echo ravine mouth and next projected threshold
time: R2 later the same personal day
scene_purpose: Turn repeated displacement into a reproducible test.
entry_state: The protagonist now distrusts the portal but cannot remain indefinitely in the scorched echo.
objective: Determine what persists and whether any action can mark a return path.
reason_objective_matters: A reliable model is necessary before another crossing risks Moss and supplies.
obstacle: The frame looks identical even though surrounding reality details differ.
opposing_agent: Resource pressure and the portal's one-way behaviour.
tactics: Record coordinates, place cobblestone outside the frame, sketch the granite seam and cross only after documenting the test.
information_revealed: The next mouth retains geography and frame form but not the adjacent cobblestone mark.
information_withheld: Whether a deliberately keyed frame can select a previous echo remains unknown.
visual_event: A marked portal foot match-cuts to clean natural stone beside the next mouth.
turn: The missing mark supports separate stable realities.
outcome: The protagonist adopts an echo-chain model and searches for prior evidence.
exit_state: The protagonist adopts an echo-chain model and searches for prior evidence.
new_question: Has anyone, including another version of him, already tested the chain?
story_value: Evidence-led reality distinction and protagonist competence.
production_requirements: Props and continuity: cobblestone marker placed outside the frame, clean unmarked counterpart, journal sketch and coordinate overlay. Capture: exact matched portal-foot compositions, controlled inventory state and a legible comparison that does not rely on narration.

time: R3 during an unstable portal interval
scene_purpose: Establish the crying-portal deviation and give the final method a personal source.
entry_state: The pair enter an echo containing a small abandoned recess near the same ravine wall.
objective: Find food, shelter and any record explaining the portals.
reason_objective_matters: The portal plane is becoming unreliable and another blind crossing may strand them.
obstacle: The only record is a damaged counterpart of the protagonist's own survey journal.
opposing_agent: Incomplete evidence, portal instability and an unseen counterpart's history.
tactics: Compare covers and symbols, read diagrams rather than prose and test the next-arrow notation against prior crossings.
information_revealed: The Weeping Atlas records one frame with many mouths, forward-only unanchored travel and a full-frame anchor route to the first threshold.
information_withheld: Who completed the Atlas, how that counterpart learned the rule and the missing safe blast distance remain unknown.
emotional_progression: Isolation to uncanny recognition, then qualified hope.
visual_event: The clean journal lies beside its weathered counterpart on matching ravine drawings.
turn: The direct-hand anchor diagram offers a route but the safety page ends at a torn edge.
outcome: He takes the Atlas and chooses one more crossing when the mouth begins to fail.
exit_state: He takes the Atlas and chooses one more crossing when the mouth begins to fail.
new_question: Can they reach a habitable echo and ever gather enough material for the keyed frame?
story_value: Mechanism establishment, identity clue and actionable hope.
production_requirements: Set and props: R3 survey recess, clean journal and weathered Atlas with a small number of readable matching pages. Effects and blocking: unstable portal state, controlled player-and-wolf positions and insert-shot lighting. Cast restriction: no counterpart actor or additional voice.

location: R4 north-wall cave and surface clearing
scene_purpose: End the crossing cycle and force the pair to live in one reality.
entry_state: They emerge through an unstable mouth with depleted supplies.
objective: Secure the destination and relight a route before the field collapses.
reason_objective_matters: Without a working mouth they cannot return to R0 or choose another echo.
obstacle: The local field extinguishes and ordinary fire produces no reaction from the crying frame.
opposing_agent: Portal exhaustion, limited materials and approaching night.
tactics: Attempt a relight, compare the Atlas recipe, inventory missing resources and move to the safest nearby shelf.
information_revealed: R4 is habitable, but a full crying frame and anchor are the only recorded route away.
information_withheld: Whether the Atlas method works and what R0 moment it would select remain unknown.
visual_event: Purple light drains from the frame while Moss waits at the cave mouth.
turn: The last ordinary relight attempt fails.
outcome: The pair are stranded and must build a life near the seam.
exit_state: The pair are stranded and must build a life near the seam.
new_question: Can a place chosen by necessity become home?
story_value: Structural transition from travel to settlement.
production_requirements: Set and effects: distinct R4 surface, inert crying frame and visible collapse from unstable field to unlit blocks. Props and blocking: depleted inventory, Atlas comparison, ordinary-fire relight attempt and controlled Moss position under approaching-night light.

location: R4 west-rim house, ravine and nearby resources
time: R4 across several weeks; personal order 4
scene_purpose: Create a lived home, establish the rug fire route and show patient portal preparation.
entry_state: The pair have temporary shelter beside the dead mouth and no immediate route away.
objective: Build a safe shared life while gathering the return materials gradually.
reason_objective_matters: The later fire and activation need ordinary causes, while Moss's loss matters only if R4 has become home.
obstacle: The compact room places an open hearth near Moss's preferred warm floor, and crying obsidian is scarce.
opposing_agent: Survival resources, domestic layout and incomplete portal knowledge.
tactics: Build stone around the flame, place a wool rug, feed Moss, use sit only for dangerous work, catalogue materials and sketch a blast baffle.
information_revealed: The cold-open house, rug, final inventory plan and Moss routine all arise through normal play.
information_withheld: The rug remains within a candidate fire-spread range and the final run will leave Moss there alone.
emotional_progression: Reluctance to humour, comfort and cautious future hope.
visual_event: Moss repeatedly settles on the wool as the crying-block stack grows beside the Atlas.
turn: The protagonist stops describing R4 shelter as temporary even while planning a route out.
outcome: Home and return preparation now coexist in the same room.
exit_state: Home and return preparation now coexist in the same room.
new_question: Which commitment will control him if the two become incompatible?
story_value: Relationship, normality, fire setup and resource causality.
production_requirements: Sets and capture: staged R4 house progression, west-rim exterior and lived player-and-wolf routines. Props and continuity: stone open hearth, wool rug, Atlas, tracked crying obsidian and glowstone. Evidence requirement: target-version hearth-to-wool fire-spread testing before lock.

location: R4 house and conventional supply route
time: R4 on the day of the fire
scene_purpose: Cause the protagonist's absence through the final portal requirement and preserve Moss's sit-state logic.
entry_state: Only the last crying obsidian and glowstone remain missing from the Atlas plan.
objective: Complete the inventory without taking Moss through the hazardous route.
reason_objective_matters: A complete supply allows eventual controlled activation, while the route risks ordinary mob and lava exposure.
obstacle: The familiar safe waiting place is the wool rug beside a fireplace assumed to be contained.
opposing_agent: The material objective, hazardous route and hidden flammability.
tactics: Feed Moss, issue the sit command, check the stone surround, leave the permanent flame and make the final run.
information_revealed: Moss is deliberately left somewhere the protagonist has repeatedly treated as safe.
information_withheld: The exact moment the wool catches and Moss's eventual fate remain unseen.
visual_event: The door closes; the camera remains on Moss and the wool after footsteps fade.
turn: A small fire spread begins after the protagonist is gone.
outcome: He returns carrying the materials seen in the cold open while the house has progressed into danger.
exit_state: He returns carrying the materials seen in the cold open while the house has progressed into danger.
new_question: Will he reach Moss before the shared room is consumed?
story_value: Absence cause, final inventory origin and fire ignition setup.
production_requirements: Conventional route shorthand, continuous inventory, sitting wolf, candidate loaded-area design and exact fire-spread timing subject to testing.

location: R4 burning house, burned clearing and surrounding paths
scene_purpose: Complete the cold open, establish Moss's absence and turn grief into the final objective.
entry_state: The protagonist sees smoke while returning with the completed portal inventory.
objective: Reach Moss, then search every plausible nearby route.
reason_objective_matters: The film must exhaust immediate care before the protagonist chooses cross-reality reversal.
obstacle: The fire has consumed the wool position, the room is empty and no response comes from the clearing.
opposing_agent: Elapsed fire, Moss's sit state, collapsed sightlines and uncertainty.
tactics: Drop supplies, repeat the water and wall break, inspect the room, call outside, search paths and trace the burn fan back to the hearth.
information_revealed: The rug caught from the open flame, Moss is gone and the final portal materials survived outside after being dropped.
information_withheld: Whether Moss died or otherwise ceased to be present in R4 remains unconfirmed.
emotional_progression: Panic to disbelief, exhaustive care, grief and dangerous resolve.
visual_event: The camera continues beyond SC-01's cut to an empty burned rug position, then follows the protagonist's search.
turn: The Atlas diagram becomes the only evidence of a reality where Moss is certainly alive.
outcome: He carries the book and materials towards the ravine.
exit_state: He carries the book and materials towards the ravine.
new_question: Can he open the route and survive its direct activation?
story_value: Cold-open resolution, fire causality, moral clarity and climax motivation.
production_requirements: Matched fire blocking, empty wolf position, exterior search, burned-state reset, no corpse or invented token and no claim of tested fire progression.

scene_purpose: Pay off the builder mystery and assemble every earlier clue into the final mechanism.
entry_state: The protagonist has the Atlas, full material inventory and no response from Moss.
objective: Construct a keyed crying frame with enough protection to cross after discharge.
reason_objective_matters: The first threshold is the only documented reality in which Moss is unquestionably alive.
obstacle: The Atlas requires direct interaction and its final safe-distance measurement is missing.
opposing_agent: Grief-driven urgency opposed by incomplete blast knowledge.
tactics: Place each crying block at the remembered coordinates, install and charge the anchor, then build the best stone baffle the cave permits.
information_revealed: The protagonist is the material builder of the connected R0 portal and had understood the blast risk before acting.
information_withheld: Whether the baffle is sufficient and whether activation precedes damage remain unknown.
emotional_progression: Purposeful construction to visible doubt, then commitment.
visual_event: Opening portal close-ups recur in reverse as the frame and surrounding geometry are created.
turn: He spends the final glowstone charge and takes the direct activation position.
outcome: The frame is complete, inert and one interaction from the climax.
exit_state: The frame is complete, inert and one interaction from the climax.
new_question: Will the route form before the discharge kills him?
story_value: Title resolution, material continuity and earned climax setup.
production_requirements: Full crying-frame build, exact coordinate match, charged-anchor prop, blast baffle and separation of candidate vanilla behaviour from fictional portal response.

scene_purpose: Resolve the final choice, death and portal activation through one causal event.
entry_state: The protagonist stands within direct interaction range of the charged anchor.
objective: Discharge the anchor, survive until the frame forms and cross.
reason_objective_matters: This is his last available action towards a reality where Moss is alive.
obstacle: The direct-hand rule exposes him to an unverified explosion radius.
opposing_agent: The protagonist's own urgent objective and the activation mechanism.
tactics: Use the stone baffle, face the portal plane and trigger the anchor despite incomplete safety evidence.
information_revealed: The explosion kills him, but its discharge successfully wakes the crying frame afterwards.
information_withheld: No survival, consciousness transfer or Moss outcome is established.
emotional_progression: Hope to shock, silence and tragic mechanical success.
visual_event: The blast whites out the frame; purple light gathers only after the protagonist is gone.
turn: Activation succeeds in the wrong order for its builder.
outcome: An active portal remains in R4 with no living traveller to enter it.
exit_state: An active portal remains in R4 with no living traveller to enter it.
new_question: Where did the keyed connection open?
story_value: Earned climax, protagonist agency and activation answer.
production_requirements: Target-version anchor test, controlled death framing, frame-survival plan, fictional light effect and an observer camera that does not imply protagonist survival.

location: Portal passage, R0 underground layers and R0 clearing
time: R0 morning at the moment of SC-02; presented after R4 death
pov: Omniscient audience camera, then earlier close protagonist and Moss
scene_purpose: Reveal the final destination, reinterpret the beginning and close the loop.
entry_state: The R4 frame is active after the protagonist's death.
objective: Follow the connection and identify the reality it has selected.
reason_objective_matters: The title, Atlas rule and requested loop remain incomplete until the destination is visible.
obstacle: The route passes through matching underground coordinates before any human figure appears.
tactics: Move through the portal, rise through stone and soil, match the SC-02 surface composition and continue the earlier moment.
information_revealed: The frame opens into R0 at the first threshold; the earlier protagonist has the clean journal and will investigate the hum below.
information_withheld: The exact counterpart history that produced the Atlas and Moss's R4 fate remain open.
emotional_progression: Mystery to recognition, tenderness and tragic inevitability.
visual_event: The camera breaks through grass behind Moss as the exact morning arrival resumes.
turn: The repeated line and blank journal identify this as Return to the beginning from the far side of the final portal.
outcome: The earlier pair choose to stay above the mouth that will begin their journey.
exit_state: The earlier pair choose to stay above the mouth that will begin their journey.
new_question: Can any later echo of the blank journal discover a safer answer, or is next the only direction?
story_value: Destination reveal, closing image, journal pay-off and emotional completion.
production_requirements: Stylised through-ground transition, precise surface match, repeated wolf blocking, clean journal and reused audio; no claim that this camera represents a surviving character.
